title: New Irish Pub?
content: Hello fellow Mall World Walkers, Has anyone been to this new Irish pub that just opened? No matter in which direction I walked, looking to browse shops and stalls, the path kept bringing me back to the fucking pub until I acquiesced and walked inside. Cool atmosphere— dim lights, cool temp, shiny mahogany and forest-green banners. But some of the worst service ever in MW and of course no food ever arrived after ordering and waiting around for hours. Worse still, the exit by the restrooms led to a foot-long balcony with no guardrails. Everyone was either obnoxious or aloof, and no server would make eye contact. And there was a game on— soccer, I think. Maybe baseball. Two guys, obnoxious and wearing leather jackets, made it really difficult to leave. They were loud and drunk, and being watched by something ominous (other than me). Somehow managed to escape but not through the way I had gone in. Anyway, 2/10– don’t let the path push you in.
